description: This file defines permission management structures and logic for a software project, including permission checks, builders, and matchers.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: Represents a set of permissions with optional expiration and various path matchers.

classes.name: PermissionBuilder
classes.description: Builder pattern for constructing Permissions objects with specific rules.

classes.name: PathMatcher
classes.description: Defines how to match paths for permission checks, using regex sets or wildcards.

classes.name: PathMatchBuilder
classes.description: Helper for incrementally building path matchers, including glob patterns.

methods.name: Permissions::can_read
methods.description: Checks if a path has read permission.

methods.name: Permissions::can_write_actuator_target
methods.description: Checks if a path can be written to as an actuator target.

methods.name: Permissions::can_write_datapoint
methods.description: Checks if a path can be written as a datapoint.

methods.name: Permissions::can_create
methods.description: Checks if a path can be created.

methods.name: Permissions::expired
methods.description: Checks if the permission set has expired.

methods.name: PathMatcher::is_match
methods.description: Determines if a path matches the permission criteria.

methods.name: PathMatchBuilder::extend_with
methods.description: Extends the current path match builder with another.

methods.name: PathMatchBuilder::extend_with_glob
methods.description: Adds a glob pattern to the path match builder.

methods.name: PathMatchBuilder::build
methods.description: Builds a PathMatcher from the builder.
